name: architecture.data-flow
observations: User opens app → app.init() → storageService.init() → loads userPreferences from IndexedDB
init() uses geoService → gets coordinates (geolocation or stored/search fallback)
weatherFetcher.fetchWeatherData(lat, lon) → WeatherService fetches Open-Meteo forecast + AQI with fetch()
Raw response → DataProcessor.processData(forecastData, aqiData) → transforms into state.hourlyData[] and state.dailyData[]
processData also generates daily cards and saves past history via storageService.setHistory()
Render triggered by scroll event → render() → iterates visible tiles → drawTile() for each uncached tile
Scroll also calls updateTopPanel(), drawFixedOverlay(), updateMinimapViewport()
User interactions (click/scrub/resize) → event handlers → state mutation → re-render

name: architecture.canvas-layers
observations: Three overlaid canvas layers in #chart-area, ordered bottom→top via CSS z-index/absolute positioning
Layer 1 (main-canvas): tiled background + grid + weather phenomena + metric layers — drawn to offscreen tile canvases
Layer 2 (fixed-overlay-canvas): scrubber labels, NOW indicator, stickman — redrawn every frame on animation loop
Layer 3 (stickman-canvas): animated stickman figure reacting to weather conditions
Each layer uses horizontal tiling; only visible tiles rendered per frame based on scrollLeft

name: architecture.tiling
observations: TILE_WIDTH = 1440px (hardcoded in CONFIG), overridden to 720px on mobile <600px width
state.PIXELS_PER_HOUR = 60 (desktop ≥600px) or 50 (mobile <600px)
numTiles = ceil(totalWidth / TILE_WIDTH)
tileCache: Map<string, HTMLCanvasElement> keyed by date string
renderAndCacheVisibleTiles(scrollLeft) computes visible tile range and draws uncached tiles
renderChartArea() composites relevant layers into the visible canvas area
On scroll: cached tiles reused from tileCache, only new tiles rendered

name: architecture.minimap
observations: MinimapRenderer class manages its own canvas (#minimap-canvas) and minimapCacheCanvas
MINIMAP_HEIGHT = 80px (CONFIG)
Auto-switches between 'past' and 'future' mode based on scroll position relative to current time index
Includes viewport indicator (blue rectangle showing current visible range)
Click-to-scroll navigation: clicking on minimap scrolls chart to that position
Mode toggle button switches between past-only and full-range views

name: architecture.key-constants
observations: CONFIG (src/store.js): CHART_HEIGHT:250, MINIMAP_HEIGHT:80, TILE_WIDTH:1440, CACHE_DURATION:300000ms (5 min), PIXELS_PER_MM:10, DEFAULT_COORDS:{lat:40.4167,lon:-3.70325,name:'Madrid'}
state.PIXELS_PER_HOUR: 60 (desktop) or 50 (mobile <600px) — computed in app.js init
state.viewMode: switches between 'temperature', 'humidity', 'wind', 'precipitation'
state.theme: one of 'default', 'neon', 'pastel' — loaded from public/themes/{id}.json
state.selectedDay: currently selected day index for rendering focus
state.language: 'es' or 'en' — persists in StorageService

name: architecture.ui-components
observations: DailyCards.js — Day selector cards below chart with weather icons and min/max temps; click sets state.selectedDay
AqiRadar.js — 4-axis radar chart (PM10, PM2.5, O3, NO2) with colored segments Good→Very Poor
PollenRadar.js — Hexagonal 3-axis radar (Tree, Grass, Weed) with level indicators
MapSelector.js — Leaflet map modal with OpenStreetMap geocoding, favorites pins, click-to-select location
FavoritesModal.js — CRUD modal for managing favorite locations with edit/reorder/delete
YearInPixels.js — 365-day mood tracking grid with legend tabs (Cell/State), detail bottom sheet, save/clear
ChangelogModal.js — Version history bottom sheet reading from changelog.js
BottomSheet.js — Draggable swipe-to-dismiss bottom sheet overlay with z-index management
SpfModal.js — Sun protection recommendation modal based on UV index and skin type
TopPanel.js — Fixed header showing current conditions, AQI/Pollen radar, alerts, UV block, SPF recommendation
PullToRefresh.js — Touch gesture handler with overlay visibility guard
ScrollIndicator.js — Horizontal scroll progress with pagination dots at day boundaries
TooltipManager.js — Hover/click weather detail tooltip with modal overlay support

name: architecture.services
observations: WeatherFetcher (domain/): Cache-based fetch orchestrator with 5-min TTL; falls back to MockData on API failure
WeatherService: Open-Meteo API client for hourly forecast + European AQI; singleton pattern
DataProcessor: Transforms raw API JSON → state.hourlyData[] (per-hour metrics) + state.dailyData[] (per-day aggregates); saves history via StorageService
GeoService: Geocoding (city→coords) via Open-Meteo Geocoding API + reverse geocoding (coords→name) via OpenStreetMap Nominatim with 2s request queue
StorageService: IndexedDB abstraction with localStorage fallback; stores userPreferences + historyData
FavoritesService: CRUD persistence layer for saved location favorites
AqiManager: AQI value→level/color/description classification + pollen level thresholds for 6 species
MockData: Synthetic weather data generator for offline/error fallback

name: src/store.js
observations: Central mutable state object (singleton) holding hourlyData, dailyData, selectedDay, viewMode, theme, language, geoLocation, favorites, userPreferences, scrubbing, aqiData, alerts, tooltip, loading, error
Exports frozen CONFIG: CHART_HEIGHT:250, MINIMAP_HEIGHT:80, TILE_WIDTH:1440, CACHE_DURATION:300000, PIXELS_PER_MM:10, DEFAULT_COORDS:{lat:40.4167,lon:-3.70325,name:'Madrid'}
state.PIXELS_PER_HOUR computed dynamically: 60 (desktop) or 50 (mobile)
No events/pub-sub — all modules read/write state directly
No imports from other project modules (standalone)

name: src/theme.js
observations: Exports getThemeColor(key), getThemeIcon(id), getThemeFont(), loadChartTheme(themeId)
Reads state.theme to determine active theme
Built-in: 'default', 'neon', 'pastel' with fallback to public/themes/{id}.json
Applies CSS custom properties via document.documentElement.style.setProperty()
Imports from src/store.js (state)

name: src/app.js
observations: Main entry point, orchestrates ~30 init functions for services, UI, renderers
Uses IIFE pattern: (function() { ... })() with no export
Pipeline: initApp() → initServices (storage, geo, favorites, weather) → initUI → initRender → event bindings
Defines render(), renderAndCacheVisibleTiles(), renderChartArea(), renderDates()
Manages tileCache Map, 3 canvas layers (chartCanvas, overlayCanvas, stickmanCanvas)
Handles window resize, orientation change, visibility change events
Sets mobile TILE_WIDTH override to 720px if container <600px
Imports from all services/ (except WeatherService directly), all UI/, all render/, all utils/, domain/WeatherFetcher.js, store.js, theme.js

name: src/domain/WeatherFetcher.js
observations: Exports async function fetchWeatherData(lat, lon)
Implements 5-min cache: avoids re-fetching if cached data for current hour exists
Sets state.loading=true before fetch, updates state.hourlyData/dailyData on success
On failure: falls back to MockData.generateMockData() and sets state.error
Imports: WeatherService from src/services/WeatherService.js, state from src/store.js, generateMockData from src/services/MockData.js, time from src/utils/time.js

name: src/data/changelog.js
observations: Exports changelogData — array of {version, date, changes[]} objects
Embedded JS data (not fetched from server)
Covers versions from initial to v1.14.0
Standalone module, no project imports

name: src/data/skins.js
observations: Exports SKIN_TYPES — array of {id, name, description, spf} for 6 skin types (I-VI)
Exports needsSunProtection(uvIndex, skinType) — returns recommended SPF or false
Thresholds: UV≥3 → SPF 15+, UV≥6 → SPF 30+, UV≥8 → SPF 50+
Standalone module, no project imports

name: src/services/WeatherService.js
observations: Exports class WeatherService (singleton: new WeatherService())
Fetches hourly forecast from Open-Meteo API (https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast)
Also fetches European AQI from Open-Meteo air-quality endpoint
URL params: latitude, longitude, hourly=temperature_2m,precipitation,relative_humidity_2m,wind_speed_10m,cloud_cover,uv_index,surface_pressure,weather_code, precipitation_probability
past_days and forecast_days configurable per fetch call
Imports: state from src/store.js, time utilities from src/utils/time.js

name: src/services/DataProcessor.js
observations: Exports function processData(forecastData, aqiData)
Transforms raw API JSON into state.hourlyData[] (per-hour: temp, precip, humidity, wind, clouds, UV, pressure, weatherCode)
Computes state.dailyData[] (per-day: maxTemp, minTemp, totalPrecip, dominantWeatherCode)
Saves past history via storageService.setHistory() within the function
Imports: time from src/utils/time.js, weather from src/utils/weather.js, thresholds from src/utils/thresholds.js

name: src/services/GeoService.js
observations: Exports class GeoService (singleton: new GeoService())
Geocode: city name → {lat, lon, name, country, admin1} via Open-Meteo Geocoding API
Reverse geocode: {lat, lon} → location name via OpenStreetMap Nominatim API
2s request queue for Nominatim to respect usage policy
Imports: state from src/store.js

name: src/services/FavoritesService.js
observations: Exports class FavoritesService (singleton: new FavoritesService())
addFavorite(location) — adds with auto-generated id and timestamp
removeFavorite(id) — removes by id
getFavorites() — returns array from StorageService
getFavoritesAsync() — returns Promise for async loading
All CRUD operations persist through StorageService
Imports: StorageService from src/services/StorageService.js

name: src/services/StorageService.js
observations: Exports class StorageService (singleton: new StorageService())
Two IndexedDB object stores: 'userPreferences' and 'historyData'
Fallback to localStorage if IndexedDB unavailable

Methods: get(key), set(key, value), getHistory(), setHistory(data), updateDayNotes(date, notes), updateDayMoods(date, moods), updateDayConditions(date, conditions), updateDayData(date, data), getAllKeys()
Stores: userPreferences (theme, language, favorites, skinType), historyData (weather/mood cache entries)
Standalone module, no project imports

name: src/services/AqiManager.js
observations: Exports getAQIInfo(europeanAqi) — returns {level, color, description}
Exports getPollenLevelByType(level, type) — returns string level for tree/grass/weed/alder/birch/mugwort/olive/ragweed
Thresholds: 0-20 Good, 20-40 Fair, 40-60 Moderate, 60-80 Poor, 80-100 Very Poor
Standalone module, no project imports

name: src/services/MockData.js
observations: Exports generateMockData() — creates synthetic 7-day weather dataset
Generates hourly entries with: temperature (0-35°C), precipitation (0-20mm), humidity (30-95%), wind (0-30km/h), clouds (0-100%), UV index (0-11), pressure (1010-1025hPa), weatherCode (WMO)
Uses sinusoidal patterns for realistic daily temperature cycles
Standalone module, no project imports

name: src/render/MetricsRenderer.js
observations: Barrel file: re-exports drawHumidity, drawWind, drawTemperature from sub-modules
Imports: HumidityRenderer, TemperatureRenderer, WindRenderer from render/metrics/

observations: Exports drawHumidity(ctx, data, y, width, height, theme)
Draws humidity percentage bars on chart
Imports: state from src/store.js, normalizeY from src/utils/math.js

name: src/render/metrics/TemperatureRenderer.js
observations: Exports drawTemperature(ctx, data, y, width, height, theme)
Draws temperature line graph with gradient fill
Imports: state from src/store.js, normalizeY from src/utils/math.js

name: src/render/metrics/WindRenderer.js
observations: Exports drawWind(ctx, data, y, width, height, theme)
Draws wind speed as area chart with arrow indicators

name: src/render/BackgroundRenderer.js
observations: Exports: drawWeatherPhenomena, drawStarrySky, drawUVSegments, drawSunnyBackground, drawNightOverlay, drawNightShadow

Draws starry sky with random dots for night hours

Draws sunrise/sunset sun icons positioned at correct hours on chart

name: src/render/StickmanRenderer.js

Walking animation cycle with frame-based leg/arm movement

Animates AQI Radar and Pollen Radar charts in header

name: src/ui/YearInPixels.js

365-day mood tracking grid with monthly labels
Legend with two tabs: 'Cell' (parameter colors) and 'State' (dots: notes/mood/cold/allergies)
Click cell → mood selector → save → detail bottom sheet with notes

name: src/utils/AlertEngine.js

Generates weather alerts for: extreme temps, high wind, heavy rain, UV extreme, snow

Returns sorted alert array with icon, message, level

hexToRgb converts #RRGGBB to {r,g,b} object
getTextColorForBg returns 'black' or 'white' based on luminance
Standalone utility, no project imports

name: src/utils/i18n.js

Embedded translations object with 'es' and 'en' keys covering all UI strings

applyTranslations() scans DOM for [data-i18n] attributes

name: src/utils/math.js
observations: Exports normalizeY(value, min, max, height, padding)
Maps a data value to Y pixel coordinate within given height and padding

registerSW: registers /sw.js with updatefound event listener
handleInstallPrompt: captures beforeinstallprompt event, shows install button
showUpdateToast: displays 'Update available' toast with reload action

clearCacheAndReload: clears caches and reloads page

Returns Y-axis {min, max} for metric types: temperature (-10,45), humidity (0,100), wind (0,40), uv (0,12)

name: src/utils/time.js
observations: Exports: dateToX(date), getCurrentTimeX(), formatHour(hour), formatDay(date), getSplitIndex(data), formatTooltipTime(date)
dateToX: converts Date to pixel X position based on PIXELS_PER_HOUR
getCurrentTimeX: pixel X of current time
formatHour: hour number → 'HH:00' string (24h)
